data.question: How many direct commercial joint ventures did Donald Trump have with Benjamin Netanyahu, and what Trump-linked Israeli ventures are documented?
data.method: Public-source entity resolution, project classification, counterparty mapping and recursive expansion through named intermediaries.
data.framework: Separate direct joint ownership from licensing, proposals, political endorsements, family ties and surname collisions.
data.scope: Donald Trump, Benjamin Netanyahu, Israeli Trump-branded projects, counterparties and intermediaries.
findings: No reviewed source establishes a jointly owned company, partnership or commercial joint venture between Donald Trump and Benjamin Netanyahu.
Four Trump-linked Israeli commercial clusters were identified:Ramat Gan tower, Netanya hotel, Ashkelon golf resort and Trump Drinks Israel.
The Ramat Gan arrangement was a trademark license and claimed revenue share with Crescent Heights; the project was not built under that agreement.
The Netanya and Ashkelon developments remained proposals and no completed projects were identified.
The H. Pixel beverage license was an implemented commercial arrangement and is the strongest completed Israel-business edge.
The claimed failed school likely conflates Trump University, a U.S. seminar company, with the unrelated Eddie and Jules Trump Family Foundation in Israel.
Trump's 2013 endorsement of Netanyahu is a documented political relationship but not a business venture.
conclusions: Strict direct Trump–Netanyahu joint-venture count:zero verified.
Completed commercial cluster count:one clearly documented licensing arrangement; three proposed or failed development clusters.
recommendations: Retrieve the full Trump Marks v Crescent Heights docket and license exhibits.
Resolve H. Pixel and Trump Drinks Israel corporate filings, ownership and license dates.
Retrieve Netanya and Ashkelon land, planning, tender and municipal correspondence.
Resolve contradictory accounts of who initiated and funded the 2013 endorsement video.
counterarguments: A private contract or undisclosed equity arrangement could exist outside the reviewed public record.
Media descriptions sometimes use partnership loosely where the legal structure was licensing or preliminary development.
limitations: The review does not include paid Israeli corporate-registry filings or complete court exhibits.
Some historical municipal and company records may not be indexed online.
unresolved: Whether Trump or affiliates held equity in any Israeli project vehicle.
Full ownership and annual-report history of H. Pixel and related Trump Drinks Israel entities.
Complete Netanya and Ashkelon procurement and planning files.
